title: Sahasa Simha
desc: Police officer Pratap unearths a child kidnapping racket during a murder investigation. He goes undercover as a gang member's son to join the criminals and punishes the guilty.

title: Bhagavanth Kesari
desc: A former prisoner is adamant about training his adoptive daughter to join the Indian Army. However, his mission is interrupted by a conflict with a ruthless businessman.

title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.

title: Dude
desc: Agan and Kural, lifelong friends, face a turning point when the latter suffers a heartbreak. Subsequently, Agan must decide whether to confess his secret love or keep his feelings hidden.

title: Robinhood
desc: A fearless vigilante steals from the corrupt to help the poor, becoming a symbol of justice and rebellion in a system ruled by greed, deceit, and power-hungry elites.
